name: run-watcher
description: Watcher: a band above the prompt for background tasks Claude starts (API calls, LLM runs, experiments, tests...), each with its category, tags and progress; output is read only when you expand it. Hides 10 min after the last one finishes.

lingerMinutes.title: Linger (minutes)
lingerMinutes.description: How long finished tasks stay before the band hides.

bandRows.title: Band rows
bandRows.description: Tasks shown above the prompt before the rest collapse into +N (1-4).

extraPatterns.title: Extra category patterns
extraPatterns.description: Words that put a command in a category, e.g. "Experiment: run_thesis; API calls: my_batch".
